THIRD_DEFECT_mutual_exclusivity.claim_in_the_tool: 'on windows whose nav token CHANGED, the label route and the shuffled-nav route are different classes BY CONSTRUCTION, so the two rates are mutually exclusive'
THIRD_DEFECT_mutual_exclusivity.why: route_label is a PER-WINDOW target from route_from_future; nav_cmd is a PER-CLIP token from a 25 s horizon. They are different derivations, so the label can equal the implied route of a DIFFERENT nav token.

WHY_THE_VERDICT_IS_ROBUST_ANYWAY: the head's output is IDENTICAL under nav_true / nav_shuffled (4823/4823) and nav_zero (4822/4823) -- a function that does not read the nav input cannot echo it, whatever index arithmetic is applied downstream. The index defect changes the NUMBERS, not the finding.
